newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Stadium Australia appoints new chairman.
newsitem.headline: Stadium Australia appoints new chairman.

text.p: The board of Sydney Olympic stadium owner-operator Stadium Australia Management Ltd said on Monday it has appointed Paul Isherwood its new chairman.
Isherwood is an existing memeber of the board, and replaces Peter Ritchie who has resigned "on account of additional extensive demands on his time", Stadium Australia said.

Event ticket-equity packages in the Stadium Australia Group were introduced on the Australian Stock Exchange in April as part of financing the construction of an Olympic stadium for the games in Sydney in the year 2000.
